cohort: The study participants were girls aged up to 13 who had children, with or without notification of rape, registered in the Violence & Accidents Vigilance (VIVA) System of the Brazilian Case Registry Database.
finding: Notified rape victims had a higher percentage of birth by cesarean section, late onset and a lower number of prenatal consultations, and their babies had lower birthweight and lower 1-minute Apgar scores compared to mothers without rape notification.
mod_finding: Notified rape victims had a higher percentage of birth by cesarean section.
